name: monday_lr_reference_v1
role: SUPERVISED REFERENCE (uses PRMBench step labels). Not a method; not a ceiling. Compares a supervised linear model on the same answer-z channels with the label-free Monday fusion methods.

population.steps: .worktrees/readout-quickest-detection-v1/results/step_evidence_v1/OOF_STEP_SCORES.npz (offsets, labels; True = error step on PRMBench rows)
population.training_cell: prmbench_qwen3_8b (6,969 answers; within-AUC defined on answers with both classes)

banks.construction: results/monday_external_panel_v1/score.py Population(F,[bank]).cell_bank(bank, answers)['V'] (answer-z channels, lf channels oriented per cell by sign of correlation with the 5-channel LEVEL mean)
banks.order_for_seeds: v2 BANKS order; TCI seed = 1000*bank_index + sorted-cell index (same as v2 dev_run)

lr_spec.model: LogisticRegression(C, class_weight='balanced', solver='lbfgs', max_iter=3000, random_state=20261003) on StandardScaler fitted on the training rows only
lr_spec.features: all channels of the bank (LR_full roster); no position channel
lr_spec.labels: y = PRMBench step error label (all steps of every PRMBench answer are labelled)
lr_spec.outer_cv: 5 source-group folds from OOF_ANSWERS.csv column 'fold'; fit on 4, score the 5th; no answer and no source group in both
lr_spec.inner_cv: C chosen per outer fold from C_GRID by mean class-balanced log-loss over the 4 inner folds (train on 3, validate on 1); tie -> smaller C
lr_spec.convergence: ConvergenceWarning is an error, as in the existing spec. Deviation: an inner-CV (C, fold) fit that does not converge marks that C as unavailable for that outer fold (recorded), instead of failing the whole bank. An outer or all-fold fit that does not converge fails the bank (recorded).
lr_spec.metric_rule: Within-answer AUC is computed inside each answer, whose steps are all scored by one fold model, so no cross-fold concatenation ranking (SUPERVISED_ORACLE_CORRECTION Bug A does not arise). Balanced class weights (Bug B rule) are used.
lr_spec.all_fold_model: for ProcessBench transfer: fit on all 5 PRMBench folds with C = median of the 5 selected C values (same rule as the existing in-sample reference)

metrics_prmbench.definitions: copied from results/monday_nested_banks_v1/dev_run.py prm_stats: within_auc = mean over answers with both classes of the within-answer AUC (rank formula); top1_on_error = share of answers with >=1 error step whose top-scored step (first maximum within 8 eps) is an error step; prmscore_top1 = 0.5*(F1 correct + F1 error) over pooled step confusion of non-control answers (classification != 'correct') with exactly one flag per answer (top-1 step, ties broken by first position)

metrics_processbench.definition: copied from dev_run.py pb_stats: top-step first-error hit = argmax step equals target on erroneous answers; mean over the 8 cells (cell-equal)
metrics_processbench.primary: LR trained on all PRMBench folds, applied to ProcessBench (label: 'trained on PRMBench, applied to ProcessBench')
metrics_processbench.secondary_check: fold-matched transfer: a ProcessBench answer in source fold k is scored by the outer model trained on PRMBench folds != k (removes shared source groups between PRMBench training and the ProcessBench answer)
metrics_processbench.orientation_alignment: cell_bank orients lf channels per cell. The LR is a fixed linear model, so ProcessBench columns are multiplied by sign_PRMBench*sign_cell to keep the PRMBench orientation of each channel. Count of aligned columns recorded.

label_free_comparators.methods: HEM_MOM_cc, MEAN_MOM_cc, MEAN_MOM_ga, TCI_ONLY_ga (the 4 registered methods); 'best' = highest PRMBench within-AUC of the 4 per bank
label_free_comparators.controls: ALL_EQ (all +1), ALL_EQ_ORIENTED (sign of corr with LEVEL mean, supplement_a2.py), DS_FILTER_EQ
label_free_comparators.prmbench_values: recomputed here with ext.fit_cell on the PRMBench cell for all 10 banks; parity against monday_nested_banks_v1 PER_ANSWER.npz for the 8 v1 banks
label_free_comparators.processbench_values: read from monday_nested_banks_v2 PANEL_A_ABSOLUTE.csv / ORIENTED_CONTROL.csv when present, else v1; N40/N43 missing until v2 completes

coefficients.lr_weights: effective weights on the answer-z channels V: coef / scaler.scale_ for each outer fold (the scaler mean shifts every step of an answer equally and does not change within-answer ranking); report mean and SD over the 5 folds, also the standardized coef; fold stability = mean pairwise cosine of fold weight vectors

label_free_vectors.ORIENTED: sign(corr(V_j, LEVEL mean)) on the PRMBench cell
label_free_vectors.DS_KEEP: 1 for DS-filter survivors on the PRMBench cell (fit_cell), 0 for dropped
label_free_vectors.MEAN_MOM_IMPLIED: OLS (with intercept) of the MEAN_MOM_ga step score on the bank channels V over PRMBench steps; R^2 reported

coefficients.agreement_metrics: cosine, Spearman (undefined for constant vectors), sign agreement (share of channels with the same sign; for DS_KEEP: share of channels where kept <=> LR weight > 0), share of LR |weight| mass on DS-dropped channels, top-5 channels by |LR weight| with block family
coefficients.family: nesting block that introduced the channel: core11, realized2, ct7_ext9, hist18, other13 (N53 minus N40), digit3

gap: per bank point gaps LR - best method, LR - MEAN_MOM_ga, LR - ALL_EQ, LR - ALL_EQ_ORIENTED on PRMBench within-AUC; paired source-group bootstrap, 1,000 draws, seed 20261007, for LR - MEAN_MOM_ga and LR - best (best fixed at point estimate)
parity_checks: N13 LR OOF within-AUC vs estimator_input_v1 LR_METRICS B13 LR_full 0.814239 (same channels)
recomputed method within-AUC per answer vs v1 PER_ANSWER.npz
